protocol_type: Clocked SDRAM command protocol (JEDEC JESD79-4). Commands are encoded on CKE / CS_n / ACT_n / RAS_n-A16 / CAS_n-A15 / WE_n-A14 and captured on the rising CK edge; a row is opened with ACTIVATE (bank group BG, bank BA, row), columns are accessed with READ/WRITE after tRCD, and the row is closed with PRECHARGE after tRP. Data bursts (BL8/BC4) transfer on DQS edges.

channels.name: CK, CK#
channels.description: Differential clock; all command/address/CKE/ODT signals are sampled on the rising edge of CK.

channels.name: CKE
channels.description: Clock enable. HIGH activates internal clock; LOW initiates Power-Down or Self-Refresh.

channels.name: CS#
channels.description: Chip select / rank select. HIGH masks all commands.

channels.name: RAS#, CAS#, WE#
channels.description: Command inputs. Decoded with CS# to select MRS/REF/SRE/PRE/PREA/ACT/RD/WR/NOP/ZQCL/ZQCS.

channels.name: BA[2:0]
channels.description: Bank address. Selects 1 of 8 banks; selects MR0..MR3 during MRS.

channels.name: A[15:0]
channels.description: Multiplexed row / column / op-code address. A10/AP doubles as auto-precharge; A12/BC# doubles as on-the-fly burst chop select.

channels.name: DQ
channels.description: Data bus; double-data-rate on DQS edges.

channels.name: DQS, DQS#
channels.description: Data strobe; edge-aligned with DQ on read, centred on write.

channels.name: TDQS, TDQS#
channels.description: Termination Data Strobe; mirror of DQS termination.

channels.name: ZQ
channels.description: 240 Ω ±1% external resistor to ground; reference for ZQ calibration.

valid_ready_handshake_rules: There is no per-beat handshake on the wire. Every command is committed at the rising edge of CK; data follows the command at deterministic latency.
READ data appears on DQ at Read Latency RL = AL + CL from the READ command; the SDRAM drives DQS edge-aligned with DQ.
WRITE data is launched by the controller at Write Latency WL = AL + CWL from the WRITE command; controller drives DQS centred in DQ.
tCCD shall be ≥ 4 nCK between successive READ/WRITE commands to the same rank.
tWTR and tRTW timing rules govern direction turn-around on the bidirectional DQ/DQS bus.

frame_format.command_frame: One clock cycle on CK/CK#: CKE / CS# / RAS# / CAS# / WE# define command type; BA[2:0] + A[15:0] carry operands; sampled on rising CK.
frame_format.data_frame_BL8: 8-beat burst on DQ launched at fixed latency; clocked by DQS on both edges (4 CK cycles total).
frame_format.data_frame_BC4: 4-beat burst on DQ (chop); internally still consumes 4 CK cycles between successive commands (tCCD).

command_truth_table.purpose: Open a row in (bank group BG, bank BA, row); tRCD before a column access.
Column read; data burst on DQS edges CL after the command.
Column write; data captured on DQS CWL after the command.
Close a row; tRP before the next ACTIVATE. A10/AP precharge-all.
Refresh (all banks idle); tRFC. Fine Granularity Refresh 1x/2x/4x.
Calibrate the output driver and ODT against RZQ (240 ohm).

act_n_pin_multiplexing.RAS_n/A16: RAS_n when ACT_n LOW; address A16 when ACT_n HIGH.
act_n_pin_multiplexing.CAS_n/A15: CAS_n when ACT_n LOW; address A15 when ACT_n HIGH.
act_n_pin_multiplexing.WE_n/A14: WE_n when ACT_n LOW; address A14 when ACT_n HIGH.

addressing.auto_precharge: A10/AP issues an automatic PRECHARGE after the burst.
addressing.burst_chop_otf: A12/BC_n selects BL8 vs BC4 on-the-fly.

burst.otf: A12/BC_n selects BL8 or BC4 per READ/WRITE command
burst.note: A BL8 access fills a 64-byte cache line on a 64-bit channel.

data_integrity.write_crc: 8-bit CRC appended to each BL8 write burst (MR2); error on ALERT_n.
data_integrity.ca_parity: Even-parity PAR pin over command/address inputs (MR5); error blocks the command and asserts ALERT_n.
